title: Augustinermuseum Rattenberg
highlights: Bedeutendes Museum fuer Tiroler Sakralkunst im ehemaligen Augustiner-Eremitenkloster aus dem 14. Jahrhundert
Gotische Plastiken, Goldschmiedewerke und Gemaelde von internationalem Rang
Begehbarer Kirchturm mit spektakulaerem Blick ueber die kleinste Stadt Oesterreichs
Einzigartiger begehbarer Dachstuhl der Klosterkirche und stimmungsvoller Kreuzgang
kurzbeschreibung: The Augustinermuseum in Rattenberg presents precious Tyrolean sacred art and an accessible church tower inside a former Augustinian monastery.
beschreibung:
Cultural Treasures in a Historic Monastery Ensemble

The Augustinermuseum Rattenberg is housed within the venerable walls of the Augustinian hermits' monastery founded in 1385. This magnificently restored building forms the cultural heart of Austria's smallest town on the river Inn.

Gothic Masterpieces and Church Tower Views

The exhibition encompasses outstanding works of sacred art spanning nine centuries, including masterpieces by Michael Pacher and Gothic wood sculptures. A highlight of the visit is the climb up the church tower, opening up a magnificent panorama over Rattenberg and the Inntal.
